name: Separate explanation and justification review v1
scope: Replay all 60 frozen development results. Review only changed valid proposals (31 expected); retain unchanged rows and upstream failures in all-attempt accounting. No stage-one regeneration, old explanations, labels or reference corrections in review prompts. No held-out inference or live app integration.
single_experiment: Add a focused review pass producing supported/unsupported and a fresh explanation. This tests explanation generation and abstention together; improvement cannot be attributed to explanation wording alone. Same model can repeat its own errors.
delivery_simulation: Offer the frozen correction only for mechanically valid supported output. Unsupported is withheld with reason retained; it is not a claim of correct original grammar. Rejected/service failures are unavailable. Any genuine error withheld or skipped is a miss.
selection_gates: No offered change to any of the 30 acceptable inputs, and no unavailable results.
More than 17/30 useful explained corrections after human review; accepted-edit precision at least 80%, without hiding misses.
Compare explanations on identical supported edits before/after; review changed decision coverage separately.
Do not adopt from one development run. Repeat promising fixed settings then validate under established held-out gates.
timing: Measure review pass separately. Any sum with old generation timings is an estimate across separate runs, not measured end-to-end response latency. Record call median/p95/max, failure counts and skipped count.
review_requirements: Model support is not semantic proof. Review actual explanations using approved useful-feedback rubric; do not swap preferred human wording into measured output.
